query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.avg_rating>=4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) FROM (SELECT p.ref_id,AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews r JOIN products p USING(category,ref_id) WHERE p.category='electronics' AND p.status='active' AND p.price>0 GROUP BY p.ref_id) r
columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.avg_rating>=4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1)
